record: *** Death registration 1928, FLORES *** - Uruguay Civil Registration Index Card 1900-1937, record 40, entry 1, page 20v. ark 1:1:QG3K-CV5Q
grade: *** THE FINDING. *** `trinidad-flores-kindred.tsv` has a CIPRIANO LERENA who married LAURIANA BELOQUI and baptised Doroteo Donato (1875), Maria Leonor (1877) and Lauriana (1891) at Trinidad. *** This is a Cipriano Lerena dying in the same small department in 1928, with parents named. *** *** GRADED AS AN INDEX, NOT AN ACT: the card says "Image Unavailable", so nothing has been READ. *** And the identification rests on a rare forename in one small department across the right span of years - *** strong, and not airtight, because two Ciprianos are possible. ***

record: *** Death registration 3 March 1925, MONTEVIDEO, certificate 47 *** , aged 77, estimated birth 1848. Husband REYNALDO PALLARES. ark 1:1:XMMG-TNSK. *** This one HAS an image. ***
grade: *** THIS IS ALMOST CERTAINLY THE TREE'S "DEMETRIA CLARA LERENA MONTANO", b. 22 December 1848, San Jose. *** Forename, birth year and the mother's surname all agree - *** and the record EXPLAINS the tree's compound name, which no tree ever does: she is "Lerena Montano" because her mother was CASIMIRA MONTANO. *** *** ONE DISAGREEMENT, LEFT STANDING: the tree gives her death as 1930 and the register says 3 March 1925. ***

record: *** Born 30 July 1850, died 6 August 1850, SAN JOSE DE MAYO *** - a week old
grade: Indexed "Ignacia Lorena Ignacia", which is the machine doubling a forename.

record: *** Married April 1882 at SANTISIMA TRINIDAD, Trinidad, FLORES *** ; born 1856. A second registration of the same marriage is filed at SAN JOSE, 20 April 1882.
grade: *** The same marriage registered in TWO departments *** - which is itself the family's footprint.

record: Married 27 April 1882 at Santisima Trinidad, Trinidad, FLORES; born 1864
grade: A second Ignacia, born fourteen years after the infant of 1850 died. *** Naming a later child for a dead one is ordinary and is noted so nobody merges them. ***
The eldest found so far, and *** he carries his father's name. ***

*** This is the "Ysidoro Belisario, 1861, father Mauricio, mother Casimira, San Jose de Mayo" already in `uruguay-baptisms-lerena.tsv` *** - the archive had the baptism from findmypast and now has the man's marriage.
*** The surname mangled three ways in one index line *** - Serena, Leren, and a married "de Dolz".
